item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00206","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C13","C17","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C13","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C13 is expressly identified in the child as the February 16 communication and supplies a concrete foundation for its drafting. Both letters describe the Executive Mansion's critical structural condition, the proposed renovation and modernization, the importance of retaining its architectural and historic character, and the need for prompt congressional action. The child then builds directly on that material by proposing a supervisory commission. C17 and C24 share the general form of requesting congressional legislation, but lack the child's distinctive subject matter and machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"On February 16, 1949, I addressed a communication to the Congress further advising the Congress of the critical structural conditions in the executive mansion and transmitting an estimate of appropriation for the renovation and modernization of the building.","parent_excerpt":"I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of Congress a supplemental estimate of appropriation... Within the last year I became gravely concerned with what appeared to be unsafe conditions in the Executive Mansion... structural conditions in the Executive Mansion are more critical than was anticipated.","explanation":"The child explicitly incorporates C13's communication, factual predicate, appropriation request, and renovation project."},{"child_excerpt":"the maximum retention of the architectural and historic features of the executive mansion","parent_excerpt":"The scope of the work now proposed will not alter the architectural or cultural features of the Mansion. The historic and traditional symbolism of this national shrine will be preserved to the greatest degree","explanation":"Both use the preservation of the Mansion's historic and architectural character as a central justification governing the project."},{"child_excerpt":"I trust, therefore, that at the earliest possible date the Congress will enact legislation","parent_excerpt":"It is my hope, therefore, that early action will be taken on this recommendation.","explanation":"The child adapts C13's concluding request for prompt congressional action to the more specific proposal for legislation creating a commission."}]}
